rules.text: Purchases made between October 22, 2026 - December 24, 2026, can be returned through January 31, 2027.
rules.quote: Need to return a gift? Our extended holiday return policy makes it easier. Purchases made between October 22, 2026 - December 24, 2026, can be returned through January 31, 2027.

rules.text: Online returns must be received by our warehouse within 30 days of the shipping confirmation date.
